turns.text: I need the parcel for SC-2074 sent to a different address. I placed the order with nell.ashcombe@example.com.
Order SC-2074 has already shipped, so I couldn’t change the delivery address. A colleague will take over and check what options are available.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer (nell.ashcombe@example.com) requests a different delivery address for SC-2074. Policy check denied the standard change because it already shipped. No new address provided and no change filed. Please review any available options.
